title: Forgive those who wrong you, as God has forgiven you.
Repent: admit your sins, turn away from them and turn back to God.
Confess your sins to God, trusting his forgiveness.
Seek to be reconciled with those you have wronged, and put right what you can.
Don't take revenge: leave judgement to God and to just authorities.
Help those who fall to find their way back, gently.
Love God with all your heart, soul, mind and strength.
Love your neighbour as yourself.
Treat others as you would want them to treat you.
Treat everyone as your neighbour, including strangers and people of other peoples and faiths, and help anyone in need whom you can reach.
Love your enemies: do good to those who hate you, bless those who curse you and pray for those who mistreat you.
Love one another as Christ loved you.
Show love in deeds, not only in words: meet people's real needs.
Practise the marks of love: be patient and kind, humble and gentle, keep no record of wrongs and rejoice in the truth.
Don't show favouritism: love rich and poor, insiders and outsiders alike.
Pray every day: make prayer a regular part of your life.
Pray the Lord's Prayer, and let it shape all your prayer.
Pray for others: for those in need, for those in authority and for those who wrong you.
Give thanks to God in every circumstance.
Bring your sorrow, anger and questions to God honestly: lament is prayer too.
Pray together with other Christians.
Pray humbly and with trust, not to be seen by others.
Read the Bible regularly, and let it shape your faith and life.
Read each passage in its context: the book it belongs to, its kind of writing and its setting.
Read Scripture as a whole: let clearer passages shed light on harder ones, and read the Old and New Testaments in the light of each other and of Christ.
Read Scripture with other Christians: hear it in worship, study it together and learn from those who teach it.
Pray with Scripture: read slowly, meditate on it and answer God in prayer.
Put what you read into practice.
Worship God together with the church on the Lord's Day.
Be baptised in the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, as Christ commanded.
Share in the Lord's Supper, as Christ commanded: "Do this in memory of me".
Prepare to receive the Lord's Supper: examine yourself, and be reconciled with others first.
Keep a day of rest and worship, free from unnecessary work.
Worship God with your whole life, not only in church.
